description:
High-tech frame

H200-29 has a strong and ultra-light aluminium frame for a safer and faster ride. It is corrosion resistant and easy to maintain. Internal shift and brake cables can help keep your cables longer by protecting them from any environment and reducing wind resistance.

Lock-out suspension fork

Front suspension fork absorbs all bumps and dents on your way. Locked suspension means that the fork remains inactive, does not absorb the pedal force to increase the efficiency of the pedals. It saves your energy and increases speed when driving on smooth roads.

Professional drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain has a wide range of gear ratios, giving you better control when climbing and more room when descending, turning and jumping.

Dual disc brakes

Double disc brakes can provide better braking effect and less impact in rainy days than V-brakes.It has a good braking feeling, use less finger force, easier to maintain, ensure the safety of the driver.

Assembly instructions

29 inch for larger men between 175 cm to 200 cm. It is 85% pre-assembled, easy to assemble, assembly tools included. It supports a limited lifetime warranty. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

【Lighter and faster mountain riding】
H200 is a mountain bike for all riders, especially new riders. The stylish color scheme and sufficient professional configuration can satisfy the needs of both daily commuting and many tough terrain mountain trails, bringing riders a variety of riding experiences. Moreover, compared with mountain bikes of around 20kg, H200 is a lightweight bike that allows you to pedal more easily and accelerate faster. Whether you're a beginner or an expert rider, start your adventures, city commutes and gatherings with friends on this bike.
